{
  "up": [
    "Select molecule_chembl_id as chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units",
    "From activities",
    "Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id",
    "Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid",
    "Join compound_structures on activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno",
    "Where assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614236'",
    "And activities.standard_value is not null",
    "And activities.standard_relation = '='",
    "Order by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units",
    "No limit"
  ]
}
